info.name: Dark Store Backend (Gateway + Auth)
info.description: Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Start auth-service (8081) and the gateway (8080) first. All calls go through the gateway.

exec: pm.test("Has tokens and ADMIN role", function () { pm.expect(j.accessToken).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("ADMIN"); pm.expect(j.expiresIn).to.eql(900); });
pm.test("Got a new refresh token", function () { pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("oldCustomerRefresh")); });

request.description: Refresh tokens work once. Re-using the old one must return 401 TOKEN_INVALID.

exec: pm.test("First address is default", function () { pm.expect(j.defaultAddress).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Has at least one address", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.above(0); });

exec: pm.test("Manager is tied to the store", function () { pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("MANAGER"); pm.expect(String(j.storeId)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("storeId"))); });
pm.test("Contains the seeded admin", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(u => u.role === "ADMIN")).to.eql(true); });

exec: pm.test("JWT has userId, role, storeId", function () { pm.expect(payload.role).to.eql("MANAGER"); pm.expect(payload.userId).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(payload.storeId).to.be.a("number"); });
